description: This file contains unit tests for URL normalization functions, specifically testing various URL components such as scheme, authority, port, escape sequences, UTF-8 characters, username and password handling, path dots, and URL equivalence checks.

methods.name: void check_url_normalizable(const char * url,unsigned int normalizable)
methods.description: Checks whether a URL is considered normalizable based on the expected boolean value.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url(const char * url,const char * expect)
methods.description: Verifies if the normalized URL matches the expected string.

methods.name: void compare_normalized_urls(const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
methods.description: Checks if two URLs normalize to the same string or not, according to the 'equal' flag.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url_length(const char * url,size_t len)
methods.description: Verifies if the length of the normalized URL matches the expected length.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__scheme(void)
methods.description: Unit tests for URL schemes, verifying normalizability and normalization correctness.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__authority(void)
methods.description: Unit tests for URL authority component, including user info, host, and special characters.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port(void)
methods.description: Unit tests for port normalization and validation in URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port_normalization(void)
methods.description: Tests to verify port normalization to canonical forms.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__general_escape(void)
methods.description: Tests escape sequences and percent-encoding handling within URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__high_bit(void)
methods.description: Tests inclusion and normalization of high-bit (non-ASCII) characters in URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__utf8_escape(void)
methods.description: Checks normalization of UTF-8 encoded characters.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__username_pass(void)
methods.description: Tests normalization involving usernames and passwords in URL authority parts.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__dots(void)
methods.description: Tests normalization of path segments containing dots, including '.' and '..'.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__equivalents(void)
methods.description: Checks URL normalization equivalences and differences.

ctags.name: check_url_normalizable
ctags.pattern: /^static void check_url_normalizable(const char *url, unsigned int normalizable)$/

ctags.name: compare_normalized_urls
ctags.signature: (const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
